description: The bar chart illustrates a comparative breakdown of three components—“Context,” “Generated Response,” and “Other”—across two methods: “Ours” and “Standard,” likely representing different approaches to context-informed grounding supervision as referenced in the paper. The horizontal axis represents the percentage contribution of each component, while the vertical axis lists the two methods. For “Ours,” the blue “Context” segment accounts for 60.6%, the orange “Generated Response” for 31.7%, and the green “Other” for 7.7%. In contrast, for “Standard,” “Context” contributes 23.6%, “Generated Response” 51.1%, and “Other” 25.3%. The chart uses a stacked horizontal bar format, with each bar divided into three color-coded segments corresponding to the legend at the bottom. The “Ours” method shows a significantly higher reliance on “Context” and lower on “Other” compared to “Standard,” which emphasizes “Generated Response” and has a much larger “Other” portion. The bars are not sorted by value but are grouped by method, with “Ours” positioned above “Standard.” No additional annotations or emphasis (e.g., shading, bolding) are applied to any segments.
